label: 数据库关系图
Database relationship graph
issueHelp: 查看当前生成来源与规则检查中的错误和提醒，不代表清空范围检查
View errors and warnings from generation-source and rule checks, not from clearing-scope checks
scaleHint: 相对图中节点原始尺寸的实际比例；100% 为自然阅读尺寸
Actual scale relative to the original node size; 100% is the natural reading size
fitHint: 缩放当前范围，让全部表与关系进入画布
Fit all tables and relationships in the current scope into the canvas
readHint: 按自然尺寸阅读当前范围，并居中当前表；可拖动或滚动画布
Read the current scope at its natural size, centered on the current table. Drag or scroll to pan.
canvas: 数据库关系画布，可用方向键平移
Database relationship canvas; use arrow keys to pan
help: 父表 → 子表 · 粗线突出当前表的关联路径，浅线为其他关系。{issueHint}拖动画布平移，Ctrl／⌘＋滚轮以鼠标位置缩放，普通滚轮滚动画布；点连线查看列映射。

Parent → child · Bold lines highlight paths related to the current table; faint lines show other relationships. {issueHint}Drag to pan, Ctrl/⌘ + wheel to zoom at the pointer, or scroll normally to pan. Click an edge to view column mappings.
completeNote: 保留下游所需的全部上游来源。
Includes all upstream sources required by downstream tables.
upstreamNote: 显示当前表及所有上游来源。
Shows the current table and all upstream sources.
downstreamNote: 显示当前表及所有下游影响。
Shows the current table and all downstream effects.
neighborsNote: 仅显示直接相邻关系，不代表完整依赖路径。
Shows direct neighbors only, not the complete dependency path.
searchPlan: 仅在本次生成及引用来源中搜索“{query}”。选择结果可阅读完整结构依赖。
Search “{query}” only within this generation and its reference sources. Select a result to read its full structural dependencies.
searchAll: 搜索“{query}”匹配的表及完整依赖路径。选择结果可聚焦阅读。
Search tables matching “{query}” and their complete dependency paths. Select a result to focus on it.
planNote: 本次生成 · 仅显示已勾选的表及本次引用来源；查看完整结构请切换整库。
This generation · Shows selected tables and their reference sources. Switch to Entire database for the full structure.
unlocatedNote: 部分问题属于整个生成计划；显示所选上下文，请结合依赖检查详情处理。
Some issues apply to the entire generation plan. The selected context is shown; review dependency-check details to resolve them.
issuesNote: 显示当前生成来源与规则检查中的错误和提醒，以及涉及的表和引用关系；清空范围另行检查。
Shows errors and warnings from generation-source and rule checks, with the affected tables and references. Clearing scope is checked separately.
allNote: 整库总览 · 总览用于看关系分布，阅读字段或路径请聚焦表。
Entire database · Explore relationship distribution here; focus on a table to read fields or paths.
readLabel: 以 100% 阅读 {table} 的完整依赖
noIssues: 当前检查没有发现问题。这里只展示生成来源与规则检查结果，清空范围须在生成计划中另行核对。
The current check found no issues. These results cover generation sources and rules; clearing scope must be checked separately in the generation plan.
notChecked: 运行依赖检查后，这里会显示生成来源与规则的错误和提醒。查看结构可切换整库；此处不会自动执行检查。
Run a dependency check to see generation-source and rule errors and warnings here. Switch to Entire database to browse the structure. No check is run automatically.
matchCount: 匹配 {value} 张表 · 选择后以 100% 阅读完整依赖

matchCount.one: {value} matching table · Select it to read its complete dependencies at 100%
matchCount.other: {value} matching tables · Select one to read its complete dependencies at 100%

locate: 定位 {table} 并阅读完整依赖
Locate {table} and read its complete dependencies
summary: 显示 {visible} / {total} 张表 · {edges} 条关系
emptySearch: 没有匹配的表或字段，可清空搜索或换一个关键词。
No matching tables or fields. Clear the search or try another term.
emptyDatabase: 当前数据库没有可展示的表。
This database has no tables to display.
emptyPlan: 尚未选择生成表。请在左侧勾选，或切换整库浏览结构。
No tables selected for generation. Select tables on the left, or browse the entire database.
emptyIssues: 检查发现问题，但当前结构中没有可定位的表。请查看依赖检查详情。
The check found issues, but none can be located in this structure. Review the dependency-check details.
emptyScope: 当前范围没有匹配的表，可切换整库查看。
No tables match this scope. Switch to Entire database.
svgLabel: 当前范围内的表与外键关系
Tables and foreign-key relationships in the current scope
nodeLabel: 查看 {table} 的字段与关系
nodeStateLabel: 查看 {table} 的字段与关系；{state}
unusedState: 其他表，不参与本次生成；{metadata}
Other table, excluded from this generation; {metadata}
